about_the_game:
This is a casual game with strategic depth—easy to learn with zero entry barrier, but challenging to master when it comes to maximizing your gains.

  • How to Play
    Spend Golden Eggs to enter, pick your Lucky Cards, and watch as the game automatically deals and clears cards. Earn rewards based on how many matches you make!

  • No Randomness
    The deck-building aspect contains no randomness—all items and reward mechanisms are clear from the start. Your deck isn't influenced by luck; your strategic choices determine everything.

  • Choose & Upgrade Lucky Cards
    There are 9 Lucky Cards, each with unique rewards. Unlock their upgraded forms by meeting certain conditions to gain even more powerful ultimate effects!

  • Plan Your Optimal Path
    Each card enhances a different aspect of your run. Which reward to take first, which card to upgrade first—every decision counts.

  • Aim for a New High Score
    Use the bonuses from your Lucky Cards to refine your strategy, build your deck, make smarter decisions, and push your high score further every time!

    Art Assets:Cup Nooble

    Sound Assets:Abstraction,JDSherbert

    Special Thanks:Yukaio,Kano
